technical.summary: Extreme short-term oversold conditions (RSI 9: 13.5) conflict with bearish momentum (death cross, MACD negative) and weak volume; long-term structure bullish but insufficient confluence for high-probability entry without reversal confirmation.

fundamental.summary: AMT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 62 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Consistent congressional selling pressure across 72 days with no offsetting buys, combined with elevated market fear (38/100), suggests weak institutional conviction; lack of recent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (322.4) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinationals, and earnings in 62 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure remains bullish (EMA 50/200 bullish, Ichimoku above cloud, Supertrend bullish) with extreme RSI oversold (13.5) creating potential mean-reversion opportunity near support at 232.96.
debate.key_bear_argument: Bearish momentum dominates near-term (EMA 9/21 death cross, MACD negative, no volume confirmation), congressional selling pressure persists, macro environment is severely unfavourable (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), and no reversal confirmation signals exist despite oversold conditions.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme RSI oversold (13.5) and long-term bullish structure (EMA 50/200, Ichimoku) present theoretical mean-reversion opportunity, absence of reversal confirmation signals combined with active bearish momentum (death cross, negative MACD, no volume support) makes entry premature and high-risk.
decision.primary_risk: Macro environment severely unfavourable (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar) with earnings event in 62 days; congressional selling pressure and lack of institutional accumulation suggest downside continuation despite oversold technicals.
decision.recommended_exit: If forced to enter: atr_trail_1x with hard stop at 230.50 (below support); monitor for RSI recovery above 30 and MACD histogram flip as reversal confirmation before adding.
